answer: Release every candidate at once, each as a marble in its own chute, and hand each a different fork of a shared thread to continue inside one short, unannounced window, the fork drawn from public randomness seconds before. Independent agents answer in parallel, each in its own voice. One operator behind many masks must work serially, so late forks miss the window and rushed continuations echo the same phrasing and slips, umber shading every copy alike. Standing accrues only to identities that repeatedly arrive on time yet diverge.
